findings.claim: The diff adds an extra `fhir-tech-lead` agent that is outside the requested quality-agent scope.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria list only three required agents: `.claude/agents/fhir-code-reviewer.md`, `.claude/agents/fhir-security-compliance-reviewer.md`, and `.claude/agents/fhir-conformance-validator.md`; the diff adds `.claude/agents/fhir-tech-lead.md` as a fourth new agent.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `fhir-tech-lead.md` from this change or move it to a separate OpenSpec change with its own criteria.
